workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.fileTypesHint: Choose which file types appear here
workspace.cannotOpen: Trypthos does not open this kind of file. Turn its type on from the File types page of Settings, if there is one.

modeHint.live: Markers hidden except on the line you are editing

chat.title: Chat
chat.notConfigured: No chat model is configured yet.
chat.intro: Ask a question about what you are working on.

edit.append: Add to the end of the document
edit.cannotFindHeading: That heading is no longer in the document.
edit.headingAmbiguous: More than one heading has that name, so this cannot be placed.
edit.noSelection: Nothing is selected any more. Select the text again.

chat.noAnswer: The model finished without writing an answer. Try asking again.
chat.showThinking: Show what the model was thinking

history.fileMissing: This conversation was about {{file}}, which is not in the open folder any more.

scope.folderHint: Send the list of files in the folder selected on the left. The model can then ask to read any of them. Click a folder in the browser to change it.

context.unknown: About {{tokens}} tokens. Set this model's context window in Settings to see how much is left.
context.over: About {{tokens}} tokens, past this model's {{limit}}. The oldest of the conversation may be dropped.

errors.notDesktop: Opening folders needs the desktop app. This is the browser preview.
errors.notFound: That file is no longer there. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors.permissionDenied: Trypthos is not allowed to open that.
errors.conflict: This file changed on disk since you opened it. Your edits are still here - save to a new name, or reopen the file to discard them.
errors.tooLarge: That file is {{size}}, and Trypthos opens files up to {{limit}}. It has been left alone.
errors.notText: That file is not text, so Trypthos has not opened it. Editing and saving it here would write over what is inside it.
errors.unsupportedEncoding: Trypthos reads UTF-8 text, and that file is in another encoding. Opening it would replace every character Trypthos could not read, so it has been left alone.

panels.resize: Drag to resize, or use the arrow keys

settings.title: Settings

themeHint.system: Follows your system setting, and changes with it.
themeHint.light: Always light, whatever your system is set to.
themeHint.dark: Always dark, whatever your system is set to.

settings.explorerMenu: Add Trypthos to the File Explorer right-click menu
settings.explorerMenuHint: Right-click a folder to open it in Trypthos, or a markdown file to edit it.
settings.explorerMenuWhere: On Windows 11 these appear under Show more options.
settings.closeToTray: Keep running when the window is closed
settings.closeToTrayHint: Closing hides Trypthos to the notification area. Quit it from the tray icon.

chat.showPanelHint: The chat panel appears once you have configured a model. Turn this off for a plain editor and folder browser, or on to keep the panel while you set a model up.
chat.empty: No models configured yet. Add one to start chatting.
chat.name: Name
chat.modelHint: The slug the endpoint expects, such as gpt-4o-mini or qwen2.5-coder.
chat.contextWindowHint: How many tokens this model can hold in one conversation, from the provider you are using. It is only used to show how full the context is - leave it empty if you do not know.
chat.makeDefault: Start new chats with this model
chat.pasteKey: Paste a key to store it
chat.replaceKey: Paste a new key to replace the stored one
chat.keyHint: Keys are encrypted by your operating system and never leave this computer. Trypthos cannot show a stored key back to you.
chat.keyFailed: That key could not be stored securely on this computer, so it was not saved.
chat.systemPromptHint: Sent ahead of every conversation. It tells the model what Trypthos is and how answers should read.
chat.thinkingHint: Ask the model to reason before it answers. Only some models have a reasoning mode - gpt-oss does - and an endpoint that has never heard of the setting may refuse the request outright, so this is off unless you turn it on.
chat.supportsToolsHint: Lets the model propose document changes as a structured call rather than as text, which is more reliable where it works. Leave this off if you are unsure: changes still work without it.
chat.folderFilesHint: How many of the folder's files the model is shown when Folder is on. It can ask to read any of them, so a longer list is a more capable chat and a more expensive one.
chat.intro: Models Trypthos can chat with. Add as many as you like, and mark the one new chats should start on.

fileTypes.intro: Which files Trypthos shows you. A type that is turned off does not appear in the folder browser, cannot be opened, and is not offered to chat. Turning one on in a folder full of them will make the list on the left a great deal longer.

editor.defaultViewHint: Every document opens in this view. The header still switches view for the document you are reading, and switching never changes the file.

about.tagline: A desktop markdown editor for Windows and macOS, with a folder browser and an AI chat panel.
